config.title: QuotaDeck CN settings
config.language.description: Controls the language of the status bar, hover details, notifications, and dashboard. `auto` follows the VS Code display language. Changes are applied immediately.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language.
config.refreshIntervalMinutes.descriptio: Automatic background refresh interval from 1 to 60 minutes. Manual refresh and refreshes caused by credential or configuration changes are not rate-limited by this interval.
config.pauseWhenUnfocused.description: When enabled, scheduled automatic refresh is skipped while the VS Code window is unfocused. On regaining focus, data refreshes immediately if it is older than the configured interval. Manual refresh remains available.
config.statusBarMode.description: `All providers` shows every configured provider family; the status bar keeps at most three segments and combines MiniMax CN/Global into one slot. `Primary only` shows exactly the primary provider below. The legacy `focused` value means `Primary only`; it is unrelated to whether the window is focused.
config.statusBarMode.all: Show all configured providers (up to three status bar segments).
config.statusBarMode.focused: Show only the primary provider; this does not pause window-focus refresh behavior.
config.primaryProvider.description: The provider shown in `Primary only` mode. In `All providers` mode it also moves that provider's segment to the front of the status bar and chooses which MiniMax region occupies the single MiniMax slot, falling back to the other configured region. The `Switch Provider` command updates this setting.
config.primaryProvider.qwen: Qwen / Model Studio Alibaba Cloud account balance.
config.providerOrder.description: Decides which providers appear and in what order, across the status bar, hover details, Activity Bar overview, and dashboard. Unknown and duplicate IDs are ignored; an empty list falls back to the default order. MiniMax CN/Global share one status bar slot.
config.warningThresholdPercent.descripti: Quota below this percentage is shown with an orange warning, and 5% or less is always a red critical warning; anything above stays green. The colour applies only to that provider's own status bar segment, never to the neighbouring providers. Supported values are 11 to 99. It applies to every percentage the extension shows: the MiniMax five-hour and weekly windows and the Qwen Token Plan windows. DeepSeek balances and the Qwen account balance are amounts rather than percentages, so the threshold does not apply to them.
config.timeZone.description: Time zone for dates and times in the dashboard and Activity Bar, reset countdowns, and MiniMax history day/month boundaries. `auto` follows the operating system time zone. Run `QuotaDeck CN: Pick Time Zone` to choose from a searchable list of every IANA zone with its UTC offset and local time, or type a zone name here. It does not change the reset instants returned by providers or DeepSeek's fixed peak-hours schedule.
